canonical_project: Terra Project Holding data center, Gewerbegebiet Tagewerbener Strasse/B176, Weissenfels
notes: Official Weissenfels council report says the city council approved the preliminary development plan for the 9.2-hectare Tagewerbener Strasse/B176 commercial area, enabling Terra Project Holding GmbH to build a data center with at least a three-digit-million-euro investment and up to 80 jobs. Capacity not disclosed.
